How the guarantee works

One primitive, however it is presented to the customer.

1

Issued as a Pass

Tokenised at creation with a unique code, traceable through its whole life. One standard, seven ways to present it.

Coupon Voucher Deal Ticket Reward Card Token
Explore Passes →
2

Held in a Vault

Every Pass a customer owns sits in one place, ready to present — alongside the balance they spend on verified offers.

Explore Vault →
3

Consumed once

Validated at the counter and immediately spent. A copy will not validate, and a Pass that was never issued does not exist.

Send yourself a real Pass and see what a customer sees — the code, the terms, and the moment it is consumed. Nothing to install, and we will not add you to anything.

Supply meets demand, through six channels

One listing reaches every channel it is eligible for. What a merchant pays depends on which channel a Pass goes through, not on a plan.
